h-mvp-body.final: An interview made it clear that Haven needs identity and community together. There wasn’t time to design both, so I split them into two phases and decided which features mattered most now.
h-mvp-body.note: His note, 9 Nov: an interview showed both elements were needed and could not be separated, and there was not enough time to do all of it, so he divided it. No mark set; rewritten from his note.
